key_impacts: About 8,500,000 customers lost power at peak.
New York City flooding exceeded 100-year floodplain boundaries by 53%.
Two New Jersey refineries shut down, causing loss of 26.3% of total operating capacity (1,170,200 BPD).
Three health care facilities in Manhattan and Brooklyn evacuated all patients due to the outage.
More than 200 fatalities occurred along Sandy’s track.
evidence_snippets: Arrival on the evening of October 29 generated a massive surge in New York Harbor.
Approximately 8,500,000 customers lost power at peak during Sandy.
As of Nov 6, 2012, refineries in Port Reading and Linden, NJ were shut down.
missing_information: Event end date not specified beyond Oct 29 arrival in NYC.
Location coverage is illustrative (NYC focus); broader affected areas not enumerated in detail.
